Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, by Your mercy, place us among the righteous
And raise us to the highest levels (Illiyyin)
And with a cup from a flowing spring
From the spring of Salsabil, give us to drink
And by Your mercy, marry us to the fair-eyed Houris
And from the eternally young attendants
Who are like hidden pearls, provide us with their service

Arabic text: وَمِنْ ثِمَارِ الْجَنَّةِ وَلُحُومِ الطَّيْرِ فَأَطْعِمْنَا
Translation: And from the fruits of Paradise and the meat of birds, feed us

Arabic text: وَمِنْ ثِيَابِ السُّنْدُسِ وَالْحَرِيرِ وَالْاِسْتَبْرَقِ فَأَلْبِسْنَا
Translation: And with garments of fine silk, silk brocade, and thick silk, clothe us
And the Night of Power (Laylatul Qadr)
And pilgrimage to Your Sacred House
And martyrdom in Your path, grant us success in these
And righteous supplications and requests, answer them for us

Arabic text: وَإِذَا جَمَعْتَ الْاَوَّلِينَ وَالْاٰخِرِينَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَارْحَمْنَا
Translation: And when You gather the first and the last on the Day of Resurrection, have mercy on us
And freedom from the Fire, write it for us
And in Hell, do not bind us
And with Your punishment and humiliation, do not afflict us
And from Zaqqum and Dari' (bitter food of Hell), do not feed us
And with the devils, do not place us

Arabic text: وَفِيْ النَّارِ عَلَى وُجُوهِنَا فَلَا تَكْبُبْنَا
Translation: And in the Fire upon our faces, do not fling us

Arabic text: وَمِنْ ثِيَابِ النَّارِ وَسَرَابِيلِ الْقَطِرَانِ فَلَا تُلْبِسْنَا
Translation: And with the garments of Fire and shirts of pitch, do not clothe us

Arabic text: وَمِنْ كُلِّ سُوءٍ يَا لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
Translation: And from all evil, O there is no god but You

Arabic text: بِحَقِّ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ فَنَجِّنَا
Translation: By the truth that there is no god but You, save us
